sources.shows: indent_style, indent_size and tab_width are separate properties; tab_width defaults to indent_size and indent_size=tab defers to tab_width.
sources.doesNotShow: Says nothing about what a reader (as opposed to an editor) should do with the values.

sources.shows: tab-size initial value is 8; overflow-wrap anywhere/break-word only break when no other acceptable point exists.
sources.doesNotShow: Does not say where breaks after a slash in a URL or path may go.

sources.shows: Content needing two-dimensional layout is exempt; code indentation and unbroken lines are named as meaningful.
sources.doesNotShow: Does not show that scrolling reads better than wrapping; concerns a 320 CSS px viewport.

sources.citation: GitHub Docs, Managing your tab size rendering preference; GitHub Changelog 2021-09-21

sources.doesNotShow: Neither page states a default size or mentions .editorconfig.

sources.citation: GitHub Community discussion 167417, tab width GA announcement (2025-07-24)
sources.shows: The setting applies wherever code is displayed, including Markdown code blocks; tab characters only.
sources.doesNotShow: Does not mention .editorconfig; commenters ask for it.

sources.citation: GitHub Community discussion 4893, tab size too wide

sources.citation: Bauer, Siegmund, Peitek, Hofmeister, Apel, Indentation: Simply a Matter of Style or Support for Program Comprehension?, ICPC 2019

sources.doesNotShow: Miara 1983 itself was not reachable (ACM 403); its details are second-hand. Non-exact replication, students.

spec.why: no study of code leading; 3.03 x-heights of the mono face is above the sibling's 1.5-1.6 em (2.73-2.91 mono x-heights) and 2.4% above Marxy's prose

off in Rendered and Source: font-variant-ligatures none plus calt and liga 0; assert on computed style

spec.marxyToday: open: no gutter in Rendered; Source lineNumbers false (app.ts line 117)

spec.why: url.sty is the incumbent; engines never break after / and break after hyphens
spec.marxyToday: open: fallback('overfull') hands the paragraph to break-word (index.ts line 164)

spec.default: inherit the article weight: 380 dark, 400 light; no separate mono weight
spec.why: sibling irradiation argument; no mono-specific study
spec.marxyToday: applied by inheritance: tokens.css line 23, base.css lines 33 and 51

operations.title: Copy the selected lines as path:L or path:L-M
operations.why: agents and compilers speak file:line (GNU); the reader needs to hand a location back; needs the source text before range.start, which OperationInput lacks today

operations.title: Copy code without line numbers
operations.why: no operation needed if numbers are generated content (measured: never in text/plain or text/html); listed to fix the invariant in a test

gaps.what: path:L-M needs file line numbers for a range inside a fence
gaps.detail: OperationInput carries the range's bytes, not the whole source (chapter 05 records the same gap for copy-with-reference)
gaps.proposal: additive `source: string` on OperationInput, ADR-only PR

gaps.what: Scroll (not wrap) for diff/patch/text/log/ascii and minified fences
gaps.detail: ADR-0033 point 5 says a code block never scrolls
gaps.proposal: only if the author opens an amendment of ADR-0033 point 5; judgement, not evidence

gaps.what: Status tints for diff add/delete and log severity
gaps.detail: twelve frozen token classes; no inserted/deleted; tokens are frozen
gaps.proposal: ADR adding two classes and tint tokens (with registry entries first)

gaps.what: Tab width from .editorconfig or a reader setting
gaps.detail: no settings UI in v1; tab-size 4 is a constant in base.css and highlight.ts TAB
gaps.proposal: one shared source for tab width, read from .editorconfig in Source mode only; the reader setting waits for v1.1

gaps.what: Slash break points inside long code spans
gaps.detail: runs.ts treats code as one unbreakable piece; no break token exists for it
gaps.proposal: a slash break token in runs.ts used only in a third pass after overfull; marxy-lb span already copy-safe

stories.summary: Break a path that cannot fit at its slashes, not inside a directory name
stories.why: only 2 of 301 corpus spans are wider than the measure but both are agent-transcript file paths; the fallback breaks them mid-segment or after a hyphen with no cue
acceptance: 1. packages/typeset/src/ragged.test.ts: a paragraph holding a 75-character path at the default measure sets with breaks only after '/'; no break after '-', '.' or '_'
2. a new typeset browser test over fixtures/corpus/18-agent-transcript.md in WebKit: overflow() is 0 for every paragraph and the overfull-fallback count is printed
3. gate:fidelity: selection text and clipboard text/plain of the paragraph equal the source bytes
stories.tasteRow: Before/after of an 18-agent-transcript paragraph with a 75-char path, dark, 960 px. Question: is a path broken at a slash easier to follow than one broken inside a directory name?

stories.summary: Add a toggleable line-number gutter that never enters copied text
stories.why: locating file:line is the reason numbers exist; Source mode has none; measured: counter-based generated content copies clean in WebKit and Chromium
acceptance: 1. new browser test (WebKit): with the gutter on, getSelection().toString() and the pasted text/plain and text/html of a whole block contain no digits from the gutter
2. new test: a wrapped line has one number, on its first row
3. gate:aesthetics: gutter number colour is at least 4.5:1 on the code background in both themes
stories.tasteRow: Source-mode file, gutter on by default vs off, dark, 1280 px. Question: does the gutter cost the calm, or repay it?

stories.summary: Assert no ligatures in Source mode
stories.why: nothing in theme-bridge.ts or base.css reaches .cm-content, so != likely draws as a different character in the code viewer (code reading, unmeasured in the app)
acceptance: 1. new test in apps/desktop/src/source/: computed font-variant-ligatures on .cm-content is none and font-feature-settings names calt and liga off

stories.summary: Scroll instead of wrap for diffs, logs and ASCII layouts
stories.why: position is the meaning; a wrapped row loses the marker or column
acceptance: 2. new browser test: a diff fence's pre has white-space pre, tabindex 0 and an accessible name; a python fence still wraps
stories.tasteRow: Same diff fence wrapped vs scrolled, dark, 960 px. Question: does the scrolling block feel like a break in the page?

stories.summary: Read tab width from .editorconfig in Source mode from one shared value
stories.why: tab-indented files are drawn at 4 columns regardless of what the repo says; base.css and highlight.ts TAB must agree
acceptance: 1. new unit test: tab_width and numeric indent_size resolve per the EditorConfig spec, bounded 1-8
2. highlight.test.ts: the hanging indent of a tab-indented line equals its drawn width for tab sizes 2, 4, 8

taste: Whether the 1 px rule plus 2ch hang reads as a continuation in nested Python and YAML
Whether a Source-mode gutter on by default suits the app
Whether the scroll exception for diffs and logs breaks the page's calm
Slash-break versus mid-directory break for a path that cannot fit
changeMyMind: A reader study showing wrapped code is misread more than scrolled code would widen the scroll exception to all code and reverse ADR-0033 point 5
A confirmed replication of Miara (2-4 spaces best) would turn the tab-width default from no evidence into a choice
Any Chromium-based Rendered shell would force the gutter to be generated content, never a text column
A finding that readers mistake a slash at a line end for the end of the path would reverse the slash-break rule
measured: Copy with line numbers: five constructions x three selections x WebKit 26.6 / Chromium 153 via Playwright 1.63.0; paste-event read of text/plain and text/html; CodeMirror 6.43.12 gutter run
Inline code line box: 32.2 px WebKit / 33 px Chromium with inherited 30 px line height, 30 px with line-height 1
Ligatures: drawn by default with bundled JetBrains Mono, advance widths identical (183.6 px)
Block widths by window: 800/960/1280/1440/1512/1728 px gives 58/65/80/87/91/100 columns
Engines do not break after slash, dot or underscore in inline code; break after hyphen and question mark; break-word breaks mid-segment
wbr copy: plain text clean, html flavour keeps the element
Corpus goldens: 301 inline spans (median 5, p90 20, max 75, 2 over 56 chars); 126 code lines (40 over 53 columns, 22 over 79, 10 over 100)
typeset run (17 px, 68 ch): 348 candidates, 218 set, 111 one line, 19 to engine (8 inline object, 7 CJK, 4 overflow after setting)

Skeptic re-run: line-number copy (5 constructions x 3 selections x 2 engines), CodeMirror copy, wbr copy and corpus counts (301 inline, 2 over 56; 126 lines, 40/22/10) all reproduced; file:// harness, not the shipped app
